name: Girls und Panzer der Panzussy die Film
source:
The GUPP die Film (Name approved by a real German) will cover the events of the der Film movie and be the conclusion of the Panzussy story.

The game takes place parallel to the original show with small changes but without massive retcons.

[From [url=https://upforkilling.itch.io/gupp-die-film]itch.io[/url]]
